items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That’s Sam Brown. That’s the same guy, played the guitar on my record.

ctx.x: Guitar. They blew it. That’s Sam Brown. That’s the same guy, played the guitar on my record.
I don’t know if he was under contract, but one of the things we found out from Kenny was he had to use an alias because of contractual restrictions.
